y-m-24-01.title: Ukuba isebenze ngo-x=0 no-x=1, isebenza kuwo onke ama-x?
y-m-24-01.topic: Ukubala ngoonobumba: imveliso yemikhuphi yonobumba ofanayo, nemizekelo echasayo
y-m-24-01.goal: Gweba ukuba ukuhlola ukuba intetho isebenza kumanani ambalwa bubungqina bokuba ibambe kuwo onke amanani, uze wenze umzekelo ochasayo ucacise ukuba ngawaphi amanani enza macala omabini alingane ngethamsanqa kuphela.
y-m-24-01.material: USua uthe, "x²×x³ yi-x⁶!" (Ukufunda: x ngesikwere iphindwe x ngekhyubhu yi-x kumkhuphi wesithandathu.) USua wafaka i-0 endaweni ka-x kwaye macala omabini ayi-0, wafaka i-1 endaweni ka-x kwaye macala omabini ayi-1. Kule msebenzi, x linani elisuka kwi--5 ukuya kwi-5, kwaye unokufaka namadesimali.
y-m-24-01.thinking.0: Ukugweba ukuba kuthetha ntoni ukuba umzekelo uphumelele
y-m-24-01.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yemikhuphi (umzekelo: x³ yi-x ephindwe kathathu)
y-m-24-01.prereq.1: Ukufumana ixabiso lentetho ngokufaka amanani angaphantsi kwe-0 namadesimali endaweni yonobumba
y-m-24-01.s.s1.prompt: Kuthethwa ntoni ngohlolo lukaSua (macala omabini ayefana xa x=0 no-x=1)?
y-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ujonge ukuba amanani amabini awafakileyo uSua, i-0 ne-1, ahluke njani kwamanye amanani.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuba ufuna ukuvavanya isivakalisi sikaSua, bhala phantsi amanani amabini okanye amathathu onokuwafaka endaweni ka-x.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.a: Macala omabini ayefana xa x=0 no-x=1, ngoko sinokugqiba ukuba kubambe kuwo onke ama-x
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.a: Uguqule impumelelo ezimbini zaba 'isebenza kuwo onke amanani'. Nokuba imizekelo embalwa iyasebenza, oko akuba 'onke'.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.b: Macala omabini ayefana xa x=0 no-x=1, kodwa asikazi ukuba ayafana na kwamanye ama-x
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.b: Oku kukucinga ngokugweba ungadluli kuluhlu oluqulathwe yimizekelo ehloliweyo. Ukuba yeyiphi x ekufuneka uyifake ngokulandelayo kuba ngundoqo.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.c: Macala omabini ayefana xa x=0 no-x=1, ngoko sinokugqiba ukuba rhoqo kubambe xa x ilungile
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.c: Wenze 'onke' abe 'ilungile', kodwa uhlole inani elinye kuphela elilungileyo, i-1. Ukucutha uluhlu akongezi bungqina.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.d: Macala omabini ayefana xa x=0 no-x=1, ngoko kuvele ubungqina bokuba isivakalisi sikaSua asichanekanga
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.d: Ufunde isiphumo esifanayo njengobungqina kwicala eliphikisayo. Oku kuhlola nako akububo ubungqina bokuba ayichanekanga.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.explain: Inyani yokuba amaxabiso amabini ayefana iqinisekiswa kuphela kula maxabiso mabini. Ukukhangela umzekelo ophula isivakalisi, kufuneka uvavanye ama-x angengo-0 nango-1.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.prompt: Fumana uze ufake amaxabiso ahlukeneyo ama-3 e-x apho x²×x³ ne-x⁶ zineexabiso ezahlukeneyo. (x ukusuka kwi--5 ukuya kwi-5)
y-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.0: Faka i-2 endaweni ka-x ubale x²×x³ ne-x⁶ ngokwahlukeneyo.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuba udibana nenani elinika ixabiso elifanayo, tshintshela kwelinye inani ubale. Unokuzama namanani angaphantsi kwe-0 namadesimali.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda wenze x ibe linani elisuka kwi--5 ukuya kwi-5.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Amaxabiso e-x²×x³ ne-x⁶ ayahluka. Ngumzekelo ophula isivakalisi sikaSua.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kule x, macala omabini ayafana. Asingomzekelo ophula isivakalisi sikaSua.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, ukuba x=2, x²×x³=4×8=32 kwaye x⁶=64, ezahlukileyo. Ukuba x=-1, zi-1- kunye ne-1, kwaye ukuba x=0.5, zi-0.03125 kunye ne-0.015625, ezahlukileyo. Ii-x kuphela ezenza macala omabini afane zi-0 nesi-1, ngoko uSua kwenzeke nje wakhetha kanye amanani amabini awenza afane.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Xelela uSua. Bhala isizathu sokuba macala omabini kwenzeke nje ayefana kwi-x=0 nakwi-x=1, awazihloleyo uSua, nesizathu sokuba ahluke kwamanye amanani.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Unokuzisa x oyifumene ngasentla nesiphumo sokubala kwayo uzisebenzise njengoko zinjalo.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Zibhalele wena ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kwixabiso xa uthatha imikhuphi ye-0 ne-1.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.placeholder: Umzekelo: nokuba uthatha imikhuphi ye-0 okanye ye-1, ... ngoko ...
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ngamagama akho isizathu sokuba ukufaka i-0 okanye i-1 kuphela akuliphuli isivakalisi?
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba unike ubuncinci x enye ephula isivakalisi, ngamanani?
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingaba wahlule 'kwenzeke nje zafana' kwi'zihlala zifana'?
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.model.0: I-0 ne-1 zihlala zi-0 nesi-1 nokuba uziphindaphinda kangaphi, ngoko macala omabini kwenzeke nje ayefana. Ukuba ufaka i-2, x²×x³ yi-32 kodwa x⁶ yi-64, ngoko ziyahluka. Ngoko ukufumana ezimbini ezichanekileyo akuthethi ukuba rhoqo ichanekile.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Zifana kuphela xa x=0 no-x=1, kwaye zahlukile kwamanye amanani. Ukuba x yi-2, 4×8=32 kwaye 2⁶=64, ngoko azifani. x²×x³ yi-x ephindwe kahlanu kwaye x⁶ yi-x ephindwe kasithandathu, ngoko inani lamaxesha ephindwa ngawo liyahluka.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Indlela ecacisa ngenani lamaxesha ephindwa ngawo x nayo ilungile.

y-m-24-02.title: Izicwangciso zokuqesha ibhayisikile: yeyiphi exabisa ngaphantsi ukuba ukhwela ixesha elide?
y-m-24-02.topic: Ukusebenzisa imisebenzi yomgca: ukuthelekisa iintetho ezimbini zentlawulo
y-m-24-02.goal: Phucula isigwebo sakho ngokulandelelana apho idatha inyuka, uze ubhale isaziso esinemiqathango esekelwe kwixesha apho iintlawulo zeentetho ezimbini zomgca zilingana khona.
y-m-24-02.material: Isikhululo sokuqesha iibhayisikile zoluntu sinezicwangciso ezimbini zentlawulo. Icebo A linentlawulo esisiseko ye-1000 won kwaye longeza i-150 won umzuzu ngamnye, kwaye icebo B linentlawulo esisiseko ye-400 won kwaye longeza i-200 won umzuzu ngamnye. Ixesha lokukhwela libalwa ngeeyunithi ze-1 umzuzu, kwaye ungakhwela ubuninzi bemizuzu engama-60 ngexesha elinye. Vumela ixesha lokukhwela libe yimizuzu ye-x kwaye intlawulo ibe y won. Ndiza kukunika idatha enye ngexesha.
y-m-24-02.thinking.1: Ukulungisa ukuzithemba kwakho esigwebweni ngedatha entsha
y-m-24-02.prereq.0: Ukufaka amanani kumthetho obhalwe njengentetho yomgca ukufumana ixabiso
y-m-24-02.prereq.1: Ukuqonda ukuba unobumba x umele ubungakanani kwimeko, njenge-'ixesha lokukhwela (imizuzu)'
y-m-24-02.s.s1.prompt: Jonga idatha enye ngexesha ugqibe ukuba liphi icebo elixabisa ngaphantsi. Kulungile ukuba isigwebo sakho sitshintshe.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwidatha nganye, bala ubhale umahluko phakathi kuka-A no-B, ujonge ukuba loo mahluko utshintsha njani njengoko idatha itshintsha.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuba udibana neseli engahambelani nesigwebo sakho, kunokuba utshintshe isigwebo sakho, cinga ukuba yeyiphi imeko eyayiya kwenza ihambelane.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Le yinxalenye yetheyibhile yentlawulo. Xa ukhwela imizuzu eyi-0 (uhlawula intlawulo esisiseko kuphela), u-A uyi-1000 won no-B uyi-400 won. Xa ukhwela imizuzu eyi-10, u-A uyi-2500 won no-B uyi-2400 won.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ukuba ubujonge le migca mibini kuphela, wawuthi liphi icebo elixabisa ngaphantsi xa ukhwela ixesha elide?
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Kulungile ukuqikelela ngobume ukuba umahluko uyancipha, njengakwi-c, kwaye kulungile nokuvala isigwebo, njengakwi-d. Kodwa 'u-B uhlala exabisa ngaphantsi' akuhambelani nenyani yokuba umahluko uyancipha.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Nokuba ukhwela ixesha elide, u-B uhlala exabisa ngaphantsi
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ujonge kuphela inyani yokuba u-B wayexabisa ngaphantsi kwiiseli ezimbini. Awujongi inyani yokuba umahluko phakathi kweentlawulo ezimbini utshintshe usuka kwi-600 won uye kwi-100 won.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Okukhona ukhwela ixesha elide, u-A uhlala exabisa ngaphantsi kuno-B
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uthe okuchaseneyo nangona itheyibhile ibonisa iiseli apho u-B exabisa ngaphantsi. Ngaba ungafumana isizathu kwitheyibhile?
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: U-B uxabisa ngaphantsi ngoku, kodwa ukuba ukhwela ixesha elide, u-A unokuba onexabiso eliphantsi
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ufunde ubume bomahluko phakathi kweentlawulo ezimbini uncipha waqikelela ngenkathalo utshintsho lwexesha elizayo.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zimbini kuphela iiseli, ngoko asikwazi ukuthi ngoku ngowuphi oxabisa ngaphantsi
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Esi sigwebo esinenkathalo esivuma ukuba idatha incinci. Usenokusebenzisa utshintsho lomahluko osele ulubona.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Kuphume intlawulo entsha yemizuzu engama-20. U-A uyi-4000 won no-B uyi-4400 won.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.after: U-B uxabisa ngaphantsi kwi-0 nakwimizuzu eyi-10 kwaye u-A uxabisa ngaphantsi kwimizuzu engama-20, ngoko kuhambelana nedatha ukuthi utshintsho lwenzeka phakathi kwemizuzu eyi-10 neyama-20. Ukuba isigwebo sakho sokuqala sasithi 'u-B uhlala exabisa ngaphantsi ixesha elincinci elide', loo nxalenye isakhona.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Gcina isigwebo sokuba u-B ahlala exabisa ngaphantsi
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ushiya isigwebo sokuqala njengoko sinjalo nangona singahambelani nedatha entsha. Sisigwebo esingenakucacisa ixabiso kwimizuzu engama-20.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kwenye indawo phakathi kwemizuzu eyi-10 neyama-20, oluxabisa ngaphantsi luyatshintsha
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ufunde ukuba ulandelelwano lobungakanani bezi zimbini lujikile waqikelela isithuba apho kutshintsha khona.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ugqibe ngokujonga iseli enye kuphela yemizuzu engama-20. U-B wayexabisa ngaphantsi kwi-0 nakwimizuzu eyi-10.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Idatha yemizuzu engama-20 ibonakala ibhalwe gwenxa, ngoko gcina isigwebo sakuza kuthi ga ngoku
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ukuthandabuza idatha ngokwayo kuyafuneka, kodwa awunazizathu zokuthandabuza. Ungahlola ngentetho ukuba intlawulo yemizuzu engama-20 ichanekile na.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Imithetho yentlawulo ibhalwe njengeentetho kwibhodi yezaziso yevenkile. A: y=1000+150x, B: y=400+200x. Zithi uninzi lwabasebenzisi besi sikhululo bakhwela phakathi kwemizuzu eyi-8 neyi-15.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kuya kulunga ukucebisa njani abantu abakhwela imizuzu eyi-8 ukuya kweyi-15?
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Kwimizuzu eyi-12 bobabini u-A no-B bayi-2800 won. U-B uxabisa ngaphantsi xa ingaphantsi kwemizuzu eyi-12 kwaye u-A uxabisa ngaphantsi xa ingaphezulu. Ukuba abasebenzisi bakhwela imizuzu eyi-8 ukuya kweyi-15, macala omabini emizuzu eyi-12 ayabandakanywa, ngoko kunzima ukucebisa indlela enye kuphela.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Cebisa ngokusekelwe kwimizuzu eyi-12. Ngaphantsi koko u-B uxabisa ngaphantsi, nangaphezulu u-A uxabisa ngaphantsi
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Le yingcamango yokufaka amaxabiso kwiintetho ukufumana ixesha apho iintlawulo ezimbini zilingana khona kwaye wahlule icebiso ngaphambi nasemva kwalo.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Intlawulo esisiseko ka-B ithe rhoqo nge-600 won, ngoko cebisa u-B kubo bonke abakhwela imizuzu eyi-8 ukuya kweyi-15
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ugwebe ngentlawulo esisiseko kuphela. Uphosise ukuba umahluko wentlawulo yomzuzu ngamnye uyaqokelela njengoko ixesha likhula.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kwimizuzu engama-20 u-A wayexabisa ngaphantsi nge-400 won, ngoko cebisa u-A kubo bonke abakhwela imizuzu eyi-8 ukuya kweyi-15
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Usebenzise isiphumo semizuzu engama-20 njengoko sinjalo kwimizuzu eyi-8 ukuya kweyi-15. Awuhlolanga ukuba utshintsho lwenzeka phi.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Akukho xesha apho amacebo amabini alingana khona, ngoko cebisa ukuba intlawulo iyafana nokuba ukhetha elinye
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uqukumbele ungabalanga ukuba likho ixesha apho alingana khona. Ungafumana ixesha apho alingana khona ngokufaka amaxabiso kwiintetho.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, ngedatha yeeseli ezimbini wawunokuthi 'umahluko uyancipha'. Njengoko idatha yakhula, wafunda ukuba likho inqaku apho kutshintsha khona, kwaye emva kokunikwa kweentetho wawunokubeka elo nqaku ngenani. Khomba ukuba yeyiphi idatha etshintshe isigwebo sakho nokuba itshintshe njani.

y-m-24-05.title: Ukuba uyalazi ichaphazelo elinye kuphela, ingaba umsebenzi womgca wamiselwe?
y-m-24-05.topic: Ulingano negrafu yomsebenzi womgca: ukwenza iimlinganiselo ezanelisa iimeko
y-m-24-05.goal: Qonda ngokwenza iimlinganiselo wena ukuba xa iimeko zingekho kunokubakho iimlinganiselo ezininzi ezinokwenzeka, ukuba ziba ngaphantsi xa iimeko ziyongezwa, nokuba ezinye iimeko azinakwenzeka.
y-m-24-05.material: Igrafu yomsebenzi womgca y=ax+b (a linani elingelo-0) ngumgca othe ngqo. UJimin wathi, "Ukuba uyazi kuphela ukuba igrafu idlula kwichaphazelo (2, 5), ulingano lwalo msebenzi womgca lumiselwe lube lunye kuphela!" (Ukufunda: ichaphazelo (2, 5) lichaphazelo apho y ingu-5 xa x ingu-2. I-x-intercept yi-x-coordinate yechaphazelo apho igrafu idibana ne-x-axis khona.)
y-m-24-05.prereq.0: Oko a no-b kwisebenzi somgca y=ax+b kuthetha kwimo yegrafu (inqanaba lecandelo lomsebenzi womgca webanga 8)
y-m-24-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kwi-a=1, b=3, faka x=2 kulingano uze uhlole ukuba idlula kwichaphazelo (2, 5).
y-m-24-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tshintsha a ibe ngamanye amanani, lungisa b ukuze ihambelane, uze ubale ukuba zingaphi iimlinganiselo ezidlula kwichaphazelo eziphumayo.
y-m-24-05.s.s1.o.a: Kumiselwe. Ukusuka kwii-coordinates zechaphazelo elinye ungafumana zombini a no-b
y-m-24-05.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba ichaphazelo elinye likuvumela wazi amaxabiso omabini a no-b. Awuhlolanga ukuba amanani amabini e-coordinates echaphazelo ancedana njani no-a no-b kulingano.

y-m-24-06.title: Isixa seekwere ezine kwikhalenda: ihlala ilungile kangakanani intetho kaJiyun?

y-m-24-06.goal: Lungisa umthetho owakhiwe ngemizekelo embalwa usebenzisa idatha entsha, misela ibinzana elinoonobumba ukuhlola ukuba umthetho usebenza phantsi kwemeko yantoni, uze wenze imizekelo yenye imeko ngendlela efanayo.
y-m-24-06.material: Ikhalenda inamabhokisi ayi-7 emgceni (iCawa ukuya kuMgqibelo), le nyanga inentsuku ezingama-31, yaye eyoku-1 yiCawa. Ngoko eyoku-1 ukuya kweyi-7 ngumgca wokuqala kwaye eyesi-8 ukuya kweyi-14 ngumgca wesibini.
